_README: Editable UI copy for the feedback form. Change text here — no code edits needed. Re-run scripts/deploy-feedback.sh to publish. (The questions, intro, and the post-submit THANK-YOU live in ../survey.json: 'description' = intro, 'completedHtml' = thank-you.)
_showOkBanner: false = on a successful submit, show ONLY the survey's thank-you page (no extra banner). Set true to also show the 'ok' status line below.

ok.en: Thank you — your response was saved. Hari Om.
ok.es: Gracias — tu respuesta fue guardada. Hari Om.

err.en: We couldn't reach the server, but your answers were captured. Please tell the facilitator.
err.es: No pudimos contactar al servidor, pero tus respuestas quedaron registradas. Avisá al facilitador.

nourl.en: Preview mode: no collector configured, so nothing was sent. (This is expected during local setup; it never appears on the live site.)
nourl.es: Modo de vista previa: no hay colector configurado, no se envió nada. (Es normal durante la configuración local; nunca aparece en el sitio publicado.)
